verdict.rationale: Runtime probes, re-verified a month apart, show a live first-party remote MCP server at mcp.reclaim.ai. It returns a spec-compliant 401 Bearer challenge and publishes RFC 9728 OAuth protected-resource metadata with read/write/mcp scopes, so a standard MCP client can plausibly connect. However, the vendor publishes no documentation for the server, and the probes stop at the auth gate, so the exposed tools and an end-to-end agent connection are unverified. Missing for 10: vendor documentation of the MCP server and its setup, a published tool list or capabilities, hands-on evidence of an authenticated session with working tool calls, and independent community corroboration.
